title: Crab and ginger omelette
summary: Crab and ginger omelette is a chinese dinner built around white crab meat and medium eggs, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Have everything for Crab and ginger omelette chopped before the pan goes on. Pat white crab meat dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook white crab meat until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook medium eggs and fresh root ginger until hot and lightly browned. Return white crab meat and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Crab and ginger omelette, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.
steps.tip: Taste Crab and ginger omelette before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
